args.common:
CONTEXT - Retrux hero, waterline anti-aliasing (20 Nov 2026, Asia/Jakarta time).
The site is a real-time three.js r184 / WebGL2 hero: ice rings above a mirror lake among snow, rocks, ice slabs and floes. Quality tiers: T0 phones / iGPU (FXAA, plate lake, DPR 1), T1 desktop (MSAA 4, mirror lake LAKE_R12), T2 (MSAA 4, higher). The user's words: "benerin pinggiran air di deket es itu kalo geser kamera kek low quality anti aliasing gitu, tapi dia aneh glitch gitu, make it smooth yaa" (the water edge near the ice looks like low-quality anti-aliasing when the camera moves, with a weird glitch; make it smooth) and today "priority benerin anti aliasing water yaa, ensure everything perfect". House rules: the user's words win; build nothing beyond the brief; look at your own images with the Read tool (zoomed crops, time slices, strips), never judge by numbers alone; report failures honestly.

WHAT EXISTS (AA3, built 11:08-13:55 today)
The AA3 lane changes two files vs BASE: app/hero/engine/HeroEngine.ts and app/hero/engine/world/EnvEdge.ts (patch: MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa3/aa3.patch; full log with every measurement: MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa3/LOG.md - read it first).
  A  tone-compressed MSAA resolve now also on the mirror lake (switch ?aaresolve=0, which also turns C off)
  B  mirror target redrawn on EVERY moving frame on MSAA tiers; before, every 3rd moving frame, which made a 20 Hz flash along the waterline (slab feet, far floes) and a stale pale block at the far floes (switch ?slabflash=0)
  C  lake-edge TAA pass inside EnvEdge on the waterline band only (pixels whose 3x3 + 4 far taps hold lake AND solid, classified from the alpha view distance vs the analytic lake-plane distance), weight 0.5, Catmull-Rom history clamped to its 2x2 footprint, variance box intersected with the 3x3 min/max as the clip, in the compressed space; no history near the hero reflection or in the hold's crest reach; skipped after 24 frames of still camera (switch ?lktaa=0; lab-only params need ?debug: lktaaw, lktaacrest=0, lktaa=1 on the plate lake)
  D  phones: FXAA 3.11 tried, made near rocks worse, dropped; T0 is identical to BASE.
  Builder's claims: MC32 -67 % slow / -64 % medium / -54 % fast (GT -63 / -62), 1/3-cycle flash peak 17.4x -> 0.7x, texture 0.999-1.002, cost +4.5..+5.9 % while moving / 0 at rest, all switches off == BASE, one unexplained 77.9 ms frame in 540.
LEAD'S OWN LOOK (13:58): SP/work3/aa3/final/slice_medium_frontslab_r690_base_lane_gt.png and slice_slow_frontslab_r690_base_lane_gt.png: the AA3 edge still steps much like BASE while GT glides. Numbers agree: SP/work3/aa3/ana/medium_F.txt edge-band error vs GT (eg) base 3.162 -> AA3 2.998 (-5 % only); MCE 2.354 -> 2.063 (GT 1.849). So AA3 removes the big pops and the flash but is NOT reference quality. Also SP/work3/aa3/final/strip_reverse_farfloes_base_lane.png: BASE shows a pale rectangular block at the far floes in its last rows; AA3 may still show a fainter one (unconfirmed).

BUILDER'S RIG (reuse it, but verify before you trust it): SP/work3/aa3/tools -
  cap.mjs  deterministic stepped capture (engine RAF disabled by an init script; one __hero.frame(1/60) per frame; scripted pointer paths slow / medium / fast / diag / reverse / leave / hold / rest; --mask writes lake / partial / hero masks; --qs adds URL params; --vw / --vh / --dsf / --tier / --mobile; read its header)
  crawl.mjs metrics per box (FS front slab, WR white rock, DR dark rocks, FF far floes left, FR far floes right, RS right slab feet): J32 / J48 (jumps > 32 / 48 levels per 1000 band px-frames), MC32 / MCE (motion-compensated), FLK, eg (|F - GT|), texture energy, halo
  phase.mjs (1/3-cycle spectrum), slice.mjs (time slices), strip.mjs (frame strips), diffmap.mjs, perf.mjs / perf2.mjs (perf2: one session, runtime toggles rotated in 60-frame blocks), ident.mjs / g8.sh (identity of images, targets and linked programs), g10.mjs, mkpatch.sh, applytest.sh, lanelab.sh (restarts the :5181 lab), lib.mjs.
  caps in SP/work3/aa3/caps (*_base, *_F = final AA3, slow_gt / medium_gt = the 16-sample GT: BASE rendered at 2880x1532 with ?lkmeach=1 (mirror every frame), 2x2 averaged); analyses in SP/work3/aa3/ana; images in SP/work3/aa3/final and SP/work3/aa3/look.

  Every headless browser goes through the shared gate: node SP/slot/slot.mjs run '<label>' -- <command>   (2 slots; hold one for at most ~5 min per batch; perf timing runs: prefix SLOT_BG=0). Never start a browser outside it; close every browser you open.

GATES (lead's binding version)
  G1 crawl: on the waterline band boxes, MC32 at least 50 % lower than BASE in the slow and medium sweeps and at least 40 % lower in fast / diagonal / reverse / leave; J48 and J32 reductions within 5 points of the 16-sample GT's own reductions. (Lead decision L1: the original 'J32 -50 %' is dropped - even GT only reaches -29 % slow / -11 % medium because most >32-level jumps are real texture moving.)
  G1b reference closeness (L2): error vs GT on EDGE pixels only (3x3 holds lake AND solid, from the masks) and MCE. AA3: REPORT only (a known gap owned by the AA4 explorers; not a finding for the AA3 fixer). AA4: edge error at least 40 % lower than BASE and time slices that look like GT at 3x.
  G2 no ghosting, trails or smear: fast sweeps, reversals, press-and-hold start / mid / release, pointer leaving the window, resize mid-motion, tab hidden -> visible, render-scale changes by the adaptive quality governor; nothing on the rings' reflection.
  G3 texture kept: lake / ice / snow gradient energy >= 0.95 of BASE in slow and fast motion; at rest identical to BASE except the intended edge smoothing.
  G4 no outlines / halos: in motion no pixel more than 4 levels outside the no-AA 3x3 neighbourhood range; also judge visibility at 1x and on a DPR-2 render.
  G5 hero (rings, orb, shards) untouched; clouds, mist, sky unchanged; no seam at region boundaries (horizon line, the resolve region edge, cloud-card carve-out).
  G6 flash gone: no every-3rd-frame (or other periodic) component along the waterline in pointer motion - also in the REAL requestAnimationFrame loop with real (CDP-dispatched) mouse input, not only in stepped captures.
  G7 frame time at T1 <= +5 % of BASE while moving (interleaved A/B, scale pinned; medians, p90, worst frame; note the 1-min load).
  G8 switches restore BASE exactly (final image, render targets, linked programs); T0 and ?envlake=plate unchanged by default.
  G9 phones (T0): waterline at least as good as BASE.
  G10 typecheck clean, 0 console errors / warnings, DPR 1 and 2, resize, no hitch on the first camera motion.
  Severity: blocker > major > minor > nit. A lens PASSES with no blocker / major / minor open.

lenses.prompt:
ROLE: independent, adversarial JUDGE of the AA3 lane. Lens = MOTION QUALITY: G1, G1b (report), G6. Read-only on every lane; never restart :5181 / :5182 unless down. Do not trust the builder's numbers: reproduce them. Time box 90 min. Work folder SP/work3/judge/motion; mirror your report (report.md) and key PNGs into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa3/judge/motion/.
1. Read LOG.md; skim cap.mjs, crawl.mjs, phase.mjs. Validate the metric code before using it (identical sequences -> 0; a synthetic sub-pixel-moving edge -> sensible MC values), or write your own.
2. Capture BASE (:5182) and AA3 (:5181) on the slow, medium, fast, diag, reverse and leave paths (with masks). Re-render a few GT frames from :5182 with the builder's recipe and check they equal the builder's slow_gt / medium_gt caps (determinism), then reuse those caps.
3. Compute G1 per box and total; G1b = edge-pixel error vs GT (pixels whose 3x3 holds lake AND solid) and MCE; G6 = 1/3-cycle and any other periodic component (spectrum of the band's frame-to-frame change).
4. REAL-LOOP cross-check: open the AA3 lab and the BASE lab WITHOUT the RAF patch (engine's own requestAnimationFrame), drive slow and medium sweeps with trusted CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent, grab consecutive frames (CDP screencast or a readPixels hook on each rAF), and check G6 and the visible stepping there.
5. Make time slices BASE | AA3 | GT for all six boxes (3x nearest), open every one with Read, and write an honest visual verdict: does AA3 glide like GT or step like BASE? Check the lead's note on the pale block at the far floes in the reverse sweep with full-res crops BASE / AA3 / GT of those frames.
Finding ids M-1, M-2, ... Each with evidence (paths + numbers) and an exact repro.

ROLE: independent, adversarial JUDGE of the AA3 lane. Lens = ARTIFACTS: G2, G3, G4, G5. Hunt for anything the lake-edge TAA (C), the every-frame mirror (B) or the mirror-lake resolve (A) could break. Read-only on every lane; never restart :5181 / :5182 unless down. Time box 90 min. Work folder SP/work3/judge/artifacts; mirror report.md and key PNGs into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa3/judge/artifacts/.
Cases (stepped captures AND at least one real-requestAnimationFrame run with CDP-dispatched input): fast sweeps and abrupt reversals; pointer leaving the window and re-entering; press-and-hold start, mid-dolly, release, re-press during the release (the hold is a slow-motion push-in with the rings moving and a wave-crest train on the lake); resize mid-motion (1440x766 <-> 1100x700); tab hidden -> visible mid-motion (large dt); render-scale changes by the adaptive quality governor while moving; DPR 2. For each: frame strips BASE | AA3 around the event plus diff maps, opened and looked at.
G4: count pixels more than 4 levels outside the TAA-off 3x3 range (same build with ?lktaa=0) and outside BASE's; locate them; are any visible at 1x? G3: lake / snow / ice gradient energy, slow and fast; at rest (time frozen) identity apart from A's edges. G5: hero mask region, sky / cloud rows, region-boundary rows. The rings' reflection in the lake near the waterline during the hold: no trails.
Finding ids A-1, A-2, ... Each with evidence (paths + numbers) and an exact repro.

ROLE: independent, adversarial JUDGE of the AA3 lane. Lens = PERF + ROBUSTNESS + CODE: G7, G8, G9, G10 plus a code review. Read-only on every lane; never restart :5181 / :5182 unless down. Time box 90 min. Work folder SP/work3/judge/perf; mirror report.md into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa3/judge/perf/.
1. Code review of aa3.patch and of the full EnvEdge.ts / HeroEngine.ts in the AA3 lane: reprojection math; history reset on resize, render-scale changes by the quality governor, DPR change, tier change, WebGL context loss / restore, a tab hidden for a long time (huge dt), hold start / end, camera jumps; render targets disposed on resize / dispose; no read of a texture that is attached to the bound framebuffer; precision (Mac Safari runs T1 through WebKit / Metal); NaN / Inf guards; the still-camera threshold; the hold crest exclusion; every switch's parsing. Try to reproduce each suspected bug.
2. G7: interleaved A/B (in-session runtime toggles like perf2.mjs if hooks exist, else >= 8 interleaved separate-session pairs), T1 at 1440x766 and 1920x1080, scale pinned, SLOT_BG=0; medians, p90, worst frame; record the 1-min load. Explain the builder's single 77.9 ms frame: is the TAA program compiled at boot or lazily on first motion? Measure the first moving frames after load and after a long rest (first-motion hitch).
3. G8: all switches off == BASE (final image hash, render targets, linked programs) at T1 and T2; ?envlake=plate; T0. 4. G9: 390x844 touch emulation (T0) identical to BASE. 5. G10: both tsc runs clean; 0 console errors / warnings; DPR 1 and 2; resize; WEBGL_lose_context lose / restore; Playwright WebKit (desktop) and Firefox (desktop): boot the AA3 lab and the BASE lab, read console / shader errors, which tier, whether the TAA runs, crops of the waterline after a sweep, compared with BASE in the same engine.
Finding ids P-1, P-2, ... Each with evidence (paths + numbers) and an exact repro.

args.fixer:
ROLE: FIXER of the AA3 lane, after three independent judges. Fix exactly the findings below - nothing else, no new features, no change of approach (reference-quality edges are owned by a separate AA4 track). For each finding: reproduce it first with the judge's repro (or an equivalent you write), fix it in the AA3 lane, re-measure with the same probe, and look at the before / after images yourself.
Rules: every switch stays exact (all switches off must still equal BASE: rerun tools/g8.sh / ident.mjs); tsc clean; regenerate the patch vs BASE (tools/mkpatch.sh) and apply-test it on a fresh clone of BASE (tools/applytest.sh); append a dated section to SP/work3/aa3/LOG.md and mirror LOG.md + aa3.patch into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa3/ after every fix. You own the :5181 lab now (restart it with tools/lanelab.sh after edits). Never touch aa3_judged, BASE, the AA4 lanes (aa4x / aa4y) or ports 5182 / 5191 / 5192. Time box 75 min. A finding that needs a design change: say so and leave it.
If perf (G7) is a finding: prefer savings that do not bring the flash back (the builder found: mirror every 2nd moving frame -> a 30 Hz flash; mips only every 2nd draw -> no saving). Ideas worth measuring: restrict the TAA pass to the rows / scissor box where the band exists, skip work outside the lake region, cheaper band classification.
args.recheck: ROLE: RECHECK judge (independent, adversarial) for one lens after the fix round. For every finding listed: rerun the original repro on the fixed AA3 lane (:5181) and decide fixed / not-fixed / regressed with numbers and with images you looked at (set each finding's status). Then rerun this lens's gates quickly on the fixed lane to catch regressions, plus G8 identity (all switches off == BASE). Read-only. Time box 45 min. Mirror your report into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/aa3/judge/<lens>-recheck/.
